id./param/scenario/cs/c_010_cs_070.pack|cs_:
"You've given us quite a lot of trouble...
  Don't think you can run from
  the great Veronica.

"Evil monster disguised as Heliodor's king.
  Give up and reveal your true form!

"I am the sorcerer Mordegon...
  I destroyed Dundrasil sixteen years ago
  and took the Heliodor king's place...

"I hunted you only to use the Luminary's
  power, steal the Sword of Light
  and gain the Tree's soul...

"But now the Sword of Light is yours,
  I'll use any means!
  This throne room will be your grave!

"So you're the sorcerer Mordegon...
  I've waited sixteen years
  for the day we'd meet!

"Mordegon... you...!
  All this time, possessing the king
  and deceiving me!?

"Hendrik... you were a fine pawn.
  No need to rush. I'll soon send you
  to your family in heaven.

"You... could it be...
  my homeland, Zwaardsrust...!

"And stealing our sixteen years.
  I can't forgive you alone!
  I'll make you feel this regret!

"{var:1}, I'll fight as well.
  He is also the enemy who took
  my family and friends!

"{var:1}! He is the root of the
  twist in your fate.
  Let's fight with everything we've got!

"Come, {var:1}!
  I'll steal your power and make an
  offering of all life on earth!
